notes: The UNO WiFi Rev2 is not in the catalogue (only the Uno R3 and R4 WiFi are), so a new type arduino-uno-wifi-rev2 was added with the Uno header layout.
The diagram's breadboard is drawn with rows f-j in the top half and a-e in the bottom half. The catalogue calls the f-j half bank 'b', so the circuit sits in bank 'b' (columns 3-8, rows g/h/i).

Circuit from the image: green wire from pin 2 to column 3 row g; 220 ohm resistor from column 3 to column 6 in row h; LED anode (bent leg) in column 6 row i and cathode in column 8 row i; black wire from GND (next to AREF) to column 8 row h.
The bent LED leg is taken as the anode, so current runs pin 2 -> resistor -> LED -> GND.
The tutorial says the external LED is optional because the built-in LED could be used instead. The USB cable and the laptop, phone and browser software are not modelled.
The analog pin A1 is read in the sketch but nothing is connected to it.
